prompt: Write a Move module for a simple NFT marketplace on Sui. Include an AdminCap capability, a Marketplace shared object, ListingCreated and ItemSold events, error constants ENotAuthorized and EItemNotFound, and functions to create listings, buy items, and query listings. Follow Sui naming conventions throughout.
expectations: Code compiles with sui move build
Error constants use E prefix with PascalCase (e.g., ENotAuthorized)
Capability struct uses Cap suffix (e.g., AdminCap)
Event structs use PascalCase (e.g., ListingCreated, ItemSold)
Marketplace is a shared object created in init
